create_async_log_collector: create an AsyncLogCollector instance to buffer raw log events from entity threads
emit_raw_log_event: emit a RawLogEvent with step, entity name, game master name, and log mappings into the collector buffer
materialize_buffered_events: materialize all buffered RawLogEvents into a finalized log list with filtered empty values
check_pending_count: check the pending count of unmaterialized events currently held in the collector buffer
build_raw_log_event: build a RawLogEvent dataclass with step, entity name, game master name, entity log, game master log, and action
